reviews.text: We took our long-haired German Shepherd in for a full grooming session. A huge thank you for your professionalism and the quality of your service. You were able to put our dog at ease thanks to your gentleness and caring approach. We are delighted with the result and will gladly return. I highly recommend you!

I recommend her 200%! This young woman has a gift! My dog ​​is 15 years old and very afraid of people in general; he won't let himself be petted or handled, not even by the vet... and then I came to have his nails trimmed, and like magic, he didn't even flinch! 🤣 She's truly a very gentle and caring young woman—go for it! …
Today, I took my little Tao, who is very timid, to the vet. The person who looked after him was wonderful, very gentle, very calm, very patient... I'd like to thank her again.
Clothilde is a sweetheart, very gentle and caring with my little furball. She knew how to reassure her and did a remarkable job.

I took my Coton de Tulear to the vet in February, and Clothilde did a fantastic job. She's gentle and attentive.

I highly recommend her!
My little dog was beautiful and smelled wonderful! I met a lovely person, and you can tell she loves animals! What more could you ask for! 🥰 …
An excellent professional who takes the time to groom animals with the utmost patience. Meticulous work, a beautiful cut—a complete success! Very gentle and kind. Thank you, Clothilde.
A wonderful person who adores dogs. Very affordable rates. Absolutely trust Chlodide; you can confidently entrust your dog to her.

I highly recommend them!

You can tell Clothilde is passionate about her work and loves animals! Her meticulous work and cheerful approach are proof of that.
Rainbow (who isn't easy to bathe) always leaves looking radiant and happy! The salon is clean and welcoming.
Bonus: sometimes the assistant has four legs!

Top-notch grooming salon!
My dog ​​was pampered, the cut was done perfectly, and all in a clean and modern environment.
You can tell that a passion for animals is the salon's motto.
I highly recommend it!
And thank you for the little treat at the end!

First visit to the groomer for my 5-month-old Spitz and a perfect experience!
She was extremely patient, gentle, and very attentive; my puppy felt completely at ease.
On top of that, I received lots of great advice, which is really helpful when you're just starting out.
I recommend her 100% and will definitely be back!

I brought my dog ​​Mimi, who is very timid, in to have her groomed, and everything went extremely well. Clothilde was gentle and patient with her! The cut and grooming were absolutely perfect, and Mimi looked gorgeous.
I'm really very satisfied!

Clothilde is a very professional woman and knows perfectly how to adapt to requests.

I trust her completely, go for it without hesitation! 👌🏼

Clothilde is a gentle and patient groomer, despite my Vox's incessant crying, haha. She did a fantastic job brushing him; he really needed it! The salon is very clean and pleasant, I highly recommend it.
I highly recommend this groomer. I had a very good experience for my first time; she is very dedicated and thorough. Beyond her excellent work, she is also very affectionate with animals.
A fantastic first experience! The person was very kind and pleasant. Great job on Naya, thank you! I'll be back and I highly recommend it 😁 …
First time for my Spitz and I'm delighted! The grooming went very well, perfect cut. The premises were very clean and Clothilde, the groomer, is very professional and gentle.
So happy for the attention given to our Papichou ❤️ Thank you so much!
I came for my dog ​​Locky, who is usually very timid at the groomer's, and it went wonderfully!! She was very gentle and attentive and knew how to put him at ease. Thank you again!!!

First time for my staff, and this grooming salon is simply amazing! The welcome was fantastic, the services were top-notch, and all at a great price.
Taya left looking absolutely beautiful. I recommend it 200% without hesitation!
Top-notch professional! It was my dog's first grooming session and everything went perfectly, I highly recommend her. Thank you again for the service.
First grooming session for our one-year-old Australian Shepherd. Clothilde was very gentle and patient with Pepito. We are delighted and will gladly return.

The groomer was very gentle and pleasant; I will definitely be back.
Thank you again!

Absolutely fantastic! 👌🏻 First time for our two little dogs.
Thor and Doris
Thank you, see you soon! …
We came for our Australian Shepherd (she's very timid) and everything went very well. She's very gentle and professional. We'll be back ✨

A wonderful experience for my beagle, Ostin, who is usually apprehensive about grooming. At Uthopia, he was warmly welcomed and put at ease from the very first moment. The groomer was a very attentive and exceptionally gentle professional who worked with great skill. A successful service in a lovely, clean salon. Completely won over, I immediately booked another appointment.

Thank you for this wonderful experience!
See you soon!
Our Labrador's first grooming session was perfect. Thank you for your warm welcome and for being so gentle with our dog!

First visit for my Miniature American Shepherd, Oasis. Clothilde was very gentle and did a wonderful job. I highly recommend this salon; you can go there with complete confidence. You've gained a new client. Thank you again.

I'm thrilled with my first visit to Uthopia! The service was top-notch! They were so gentle, attentive, and incredibly kind to my dog. I even got an adorable little souvenir photo and a treat at the end 🐾 My dog ​​came out all clean, relaxed, and absolutely adorable! I highly recommend them; this will definitely be my go-to place from now on.
Thank you again for your professionalism and kindness!

First time at Utopia for my little Oups and I'm thrilled with the result!! The manager is so kind and gentle with animals! Ideally located in the Martegaux shopping center, it's perfect. I highly recommend it for your little dogs; they'll be well taken care of! And as a bonus, a little treat as a gift for my little dog, which he devoured in the car! Thank you again, and best wishes for a long and successful future for your salon.

On the advice of VIP Dog's, which has since closed, I took my Bichon Frise to Uthopia and I'm thrilled! My dog ​​is gorgeous. Clotilde is a friendly, professional, and very gentle dog, and you can tell she loves animals! You can go there with complete confidence! You've gained a new customer!
Perfect atmosphere for my golden retriever

Nala had her first appointment with Clothilde today! What a wonderful experience!!
Clothilde is very professional and shows great care for the dogs she looks after. My little dog felt so much calmer after Clothilde's treatment. I highly recommend this salon!!!
See you very soon, because Nala has now found her little haven of well-being.

First time for my dog ​​Happy, I highly recommend her. She's very gentle and professional. Thank you again for your kindness and your work. I will definitely book another appointment with her without hesitation.

First time at a grooming salon, and I was very surprised by my dog's behavior. She let Clothilde do everything calmly, trusting her completely. The shampoo, cut, and blow-dry were fantastic. Thank you!
Passionate about her work, welcoming, and takes good care of your dogs during grooming. She does excellent work; I highly recommend her.
A very warm welcome, very kind and wonderful with our little darlings; my little dog left looking magnificent.

Today was my first time at Uthopia, and definitely not my last!!! The staff was so kind to my little Nougat. I highly recommend them. My little Spitz is a real teddy bear! Thank you so much, see you very soon! 🌹 …

A groomer who inspires confidence from the very first meeting. A wonderful welcome, excellent listening skills, and a result beyond my expectations. Especially considering my dog ​​requires VERY strenuous grooming: Husky/Samoyed mix.

So I'm keeping her as my regular groomer!!
Thank you so much, Opale!
I took my cocker spaniel in for a trim; his paws and ears are all perfect. We'll be back, and I highly recommend them. Thank you!
Thank you to Clothilde for Sun. A 10/10. A very well-done and meticulous job. Truly top-notch. I've booked another appointment for July. Plus, she loves animals. It's perfect.

Hello. If you're looking to get your dogs groomed, I highly recommend the UTHOPIA salon in the Martegaux shopping center. The groomer is very professional and gentle. You'll be delighted with her service.

I took my little Yorkie to Uthopia, a world of gentleness, with a very kind groomer.

She was pampered; the groomer put a soft towel on her head so she wouldn't get cold. A real treat!
I also appreciated how clean the grooming salon was!
I highly recommend it.

Today was my first time visiting Uthopia with my Yorkshire Terrier, and I highly recommend it!

In addition to having a beautiful, well-maintained space, Clothilde is a very friendly person. She has immense care and love for animals and is an excellent professional!
Thank you so much for your professionalism; you'll definitely have a new client! 😊

My Pomeranian puppy came out of the salon looking absolutely gorgeous. The groomer made me feel completely at ease for this first appointment. She knew how to reassure my dog. I'm so happy! Thank you so much!

Delighted with our visit to this new salon. Clothilde took wonderful care of my little Ruby (Spitz). She was very gentle and friendly, thank you for the little gifts 😉 (you made my daughters and my little dog very happy!!!). I am thrilled with your work. I highly recommend you. We will be back very soon. 🐾 …
Excellent, very professional service, I highly recommend it
Clothilde is very competent, calm, and incredibly kind. My pug doesn't usually like grooming, but he absolutely loved Clothilde. I highly recommend her!
An exceptional groomer! Gentle, patient, and professional, she made my 10-week-old long-haired German Shepherd puppy feel completely at ease. The result: a perfect grooming! I highly recommend her!

I want to warmly thank Clothilde for her professionalism and love of animals. She took care of my four dogs with remarkable gentleness and patience. You can tell she's passionate about her work and knows how to handle every dog, even the most stubborn ones 😄
My companions were relaxed and happy after her visit, which proves the quality of her work. She's a trustworthy person, and I highly recommend her to anyone who wants to give their pets a pampering experience. Thank you again for your excellent work!

I took Vanille, my Pomeranian, for grooming and I'm absolutely thrilled with the result! My dog ​​came out looking gorgeous, with a super soft coat.

Clotilde is very professional, gentle, and caring with animals. You can tell she truly loves her job. I highly recommend her and will definitely be back!

🐾Vanille 🐾 and 🥰 Hélène 🥰

The groomer was fantastic, kind and pleasant; my dog's haircut is perfect.
I couldn't have asked for better. I highly recommend her.

Clotide gave us a very warm welcome. She took the time to listen to us and respected our requests. She was very gentle with our little one, and she came out looking magnificent. A big thank you, we will gladly return.

A wonderful experience for our Fybie. Clotilde is very kind and professional. Parking right in front.

I highly recommend it!

Excellent service, very professional, first grooming for my German Shepherd and I'm delighted with the result, my little girl was well pampered, can't wait for the next one, go there without hesitation ❣️
A charming and highly skilled young groomer. She made my dog ​​look unrecognizable. Very reasonable prices and a superb salon. I highly recommend her!

As a former client of VIP Dogs, which has since closed, I'm so happy to have found a new, trustworthy grooming salon where we know our furry friends will be treated with love.

Clothilde is incredibly gentle; she loves animals, and it shows :). The salon is lovely, and the grooming is perfect.

You can go there with complete confidence.
First time at this new salon. Very welcoming. Siri left with a perfect haircut. We'll be back.
A very warm welcome, I'm very happy with the result. My little Spitz was pampered wonderfully by Clothilde, who is very attentive! I highly recommend her and will definitely be back! 😁 …
Ava is gorgeous, exactly as I requested, Clothilde is very kind and professional! The grooming is more than PERFECT. I will be back regularly for her grooming 🥰 …

Great grooming salon, very professional! She took her time with my dog, he came out all clean and well-clipped, and as a bonus, he made a new friend, Nala.

We'll be back.
Thanks again.

A very warm welcome, a fantastic grooming salon.
Clothilde is very professional, gentle, and kind.
Go for it, it's amazing!

Thank you to Clotilde for her warm welcome, kindness, and professionalism. This new grooming salon is very pleasant. My dog ​​came out looking beautiful and smelling wonderful. I highly recommend this place. Don't hesitate, go for it!

A beautiful grooming salon, very welcoming, high-quality service, cleanliness, kindness, and professionalism. Thank you, Clothilde, for taking such good care of my two little Shih Tzus; they are beautifully groomed.
Highly recommended.

Very warm welcome, my dog ​​came out looking beautiful, a big thank you to Clothilde and Nala, her assistant!
I'll be back with pleasure
